scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin & Urban (PMAY)
application_mode: Gram Panchayat Awaas+ Survey (Gramin) / Citizen Assessment Portal (Urban)
target_beneficiaries: Homeless families and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural and urban areas.
financial_subsidy: Rural: ₹1,20,000 (Plains) / ₹1,30,000 (Hilly/NE/IAP districts) in 3 installments + ₹12,000 Swachh Bharat toilet grant + 90/95 days MGNREGS wage employment. Urban: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh under CLSS / ₹1.5 Lakh central assistance under BLC (Beneficiary-led Construction).
prerequisites: Aadhaar numbers of all family members
Clear land possession deed / Gram Panchayat residential patta
MGNREGA Job Card (for rural wage labor component)
DBT-enabled Bank Account solely or jointly with female head of household

application_steps.portal_action: Awaas+ survey registration / Urban demand survey through Urban Local Body (ULB) or online citizen assessment.

input_fields.name: head_of_household_gender
input_fields.description: Preference for female or joint ownership

application_steps.verification: Gram Sabha approves SECC/Awaas+ priority beneficiary list.

application_steps.portal_action: Data entry on AwaasSoft by Block Development Office / CSC. Link bank account and MGNREGA Job Card.

input_fields.name: bank_account_dbt
input_fields.description: Aadhaar seeded bank account in name of female head

input_fields.name: land_possession_patta_pdf
input_fields.description: Homestead land allotment or ownership title deed

application_steps.verification: PFMS account validation and Block Officer sanction order.

application_steps.portal_action: Field inspector conducts mobile geo-tagged photography before each installment.

input_fields.name: stage_1_foundation
input_fields.description: Geo-tag: Old kutcha site -> 1st Installment (₹40,000) released

input_fields.name: stage_2_lintel
input_fields.description: Geo-tag: Lintel / Wall level -> 2nd Installment (₹60,000) released

input_fields.name: stage_3_roof_and_toilet
input_fields.description: Geo-tag: Roof cast + Swachh Bharat toilet -> Final Installment (₹20,000) released

application_steps.verification: AwaasApp mobile geo-tag inspection with GPS latitude/longitude verification.
application_steps.output_artifact: Completion Certificate and house handover plaque with PMAY logo.
